data.title: The Startup Simulator
data.statement:
You're going to be helping a budding entrepreneur determine if their business venture is <<profitable, breaking even>>, or <<losing money>>. You must calculate the [[Total Cost]], the [[Net Profit]], and the [[Profit Margin percentage]].

<<Formulas:>>
[[Total Cost]] = Fixed Cost ([[fc]]) + Variable Cost ([[vc]])
[[Net Result]] = [[revenue]] - [[Total Cost]]
[[Profit Margin percentage]] = ([[Net Result]] / [[revenue]]) × {{100}}

Note: If [[revenue]] is {{0}}, [[Profit Margin percentage]] is automatically {{-100%}}.

<<Output Requirements:>>
Your program must output a single line summarizing the financial status:

If [[Net Result]] is {{0}}: {{BREAK-EVEN}}
Otherwise: [[status]] {{| Net:}} [[Net Result]] {{| Margin:}} [[Profit Margin percentage]]{{%}}
where [[status]] is either:
{{PROFITABLE}} if [[Net Result]] is greater than {{0}}, or
{{LOSS}} if [[Net Result]] is less than {{0}}.
All numerical values in the final text must be rounded to the nearest whole integer.

lastVersion.statementHTML:
Goal

You're going to be helping a budding entrepreneur determine if their business venture is profitable, breaking even, or losing money. You must calculate the Total Cost, the Net Profit, and the Profit Margin percentage.

Formulas:
Total Cost = Fixed Cost (fc) + Variable Cost (vc)
Net Result = revenue - Total Cost
Profit Margin percentage = (Net Result / revenue) × 100

Note: If revenue is 0, Profit Margin percentage is automatically -100%.

Output Requirements:
Your program must output a single line summarizing the financial status:

If Net Result is 0: BREAK-EVEN
Otherwise: status | Net: Net Result | Margin: Profit Margin percentage%
where status is either:
PROFITABLE if Net Result is greater than 0, or
LOSS if Net Result is less than 0.
All numerical values in the final text must be rounded to the nearest whole integer.
Input
Line 1: An integer fc for Fixed Cost
Line 2: An integer vc for Variable Cost
Line 3: An integer revenue for the Total Revenue
Output
A single string containing the financial status, net profit/loss, and margin as formatted above.
Constraints
0 ≤ fc, vc, revenue ≤ 1,000,000
Example
Input
10000
5000
25000
Output
PROFITABLE | Net: 10000 | Margin: 40%
